mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, b.order_no, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyer_customer_id, buyer.nickname AS buyer_nickname, b.contact_name, b.contact_phone, b.participant_count, b.quoted_amount, b.payable_amount, (b.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ql_registration ready WHERE ready.batch_id=b.id AND ready.registration_status <> 'confirmed')) AS batch_ready_for_payment, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.final_amount ELSE r.final_amount END AS final_amount, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.settlement_status ELSE r.settlement_status END AS settlement_status, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.settlement_type ELSE r.settlement_type END AS settlement_type, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.pass_units ELSE r.pass_units END AS pass_units, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.pass_account_id ELSE r.pass_account_id END AS pass_account_id, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.settlement_note ELSE r.settlement_note END AS settlement_note, CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.current_settlement_id ELSE r.current_settlement_id END AS current_settlement_id, b.payment_status AS batch_payment_status, r.customer_id, c.customer_no, c.nickname, c.real_name, r.session_id, s.session_number, s.name AS session_name, COALESCE(r.unit_price,s.standard_price) AS standard_price, r.registration_status, r.payment_status, r.registration_source, r.registered_at, r.session_referrer_customer_id, ref.nickname AS referrer_nickname, r.return_primary_trigger, r.return_trigger_note, r.attribution_source, r.remark, r.revision
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ql_registration r INNER JOIN ql_customer c ON c.id = r.customer_id INNER JOIN ql_session s ON s.id = r.session_id LEFT JOIN ql_registration_batch b ON b.id = r.batch_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer buyer ON buyer.id = b.submitted_by_customer_id LEFT JOIN ql_customer ref ON ref.id = r.session_referrer_customer_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.session_id AS sessionId, b.submitted_by_customer_id AS buyerCustomerId, b.payment_status AS paymentStatus, b.quoted_amount AS quotedAmount, b.payable_amount AS payableAmount, b.final_amount AS finalAmount, b.settlement_status AS settlementStatus, b.settlement_type AS settlementType, b.pass_units AS passUnits, b.pass_account_id AS passAccountId, b.current_settlement_id AS currentSettlementId FROM ql_registration_batch b WHERE b.id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, registration_id AS registrationId, registration_batch_id AS batchId, quoted_amount AS quotedAmount, final_amount AS finalAmount, settlement_type AS settlementType, pass_units AS passUnits, pass_account_id AS passAccountId, pass_balance_after AS passBalanceAfter, note, operator_id AS operatorId, confirmed_at AS confirmedAt FROM ql_settlement_log WHERE id=#{settlementId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT settlement_id AS settlementId, registration_id AS registrationId, registration_batch_id AS batchId FROM ql_settlement_reversal WHERE settlement_id=#{settlementId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ql_transaction WHERE registration_batch_id=#{batchId} AND transaction_type='session' AND status='paid'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ql_transaction WHERE registration_id=#{registrationId} AND transaction_type='session' AND status='paid'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ql_pass_ledger WHERE settlement_id=#{settlementId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ql_registration_batch SET final_amount=NULL, payable_amount=quoted_amount, settlement_status='pending', settlement_type=NULL, pass_units=NULL, pass_account_id=NULL, settlement_note=NULL, settlement_confirmed_by=NULL, settlement_confirmed_at=NULL, current_settlement_id=NULL WHERE id=#{batchId} AND settlement_status='confirmed' AND current_settlement_id=#{settlementId}

UPDATE ql_registration SET final_amount=NULL, settlement_status='pending', settlement_type=NULL, pass_units=NULL, pass_account_id=NULL, settlement_note=NULL, settlement_confirmed_by=NULL, settlement_confirmed_at=NULL, current_settlement_id=NULL, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_at=#{updatedAt}, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{registrationId} AND settlement_status='confirmed' AND current_settlement_id=#{settlementId}
UPDATE ql_settlement_log SET pass_balance_after=#{passBalanceAfter} WHERE id=#{settlementId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ql_registration WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ql_registration_batch SET final_amount=#{finalAmount}, payable_amount=#{finalAmount}, settlement_status='confirmed', settlement_type=#{settlementType}, pass_units=#{passUnits}, pass_account_id=#{passAccountId}, settlement_note=#{note}, settlement_confirmed_by=#{operatorId}, settlement_confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt}, current_settlement_id=#{settlementId} WHERE id=#{batchId} AND payment_status='unpaid' AND settlement_status='pending'

UPDATE ql_registration SET final_amount=#{finalAmount}, settlement_status='confirmed', settlement_type=#{settlementType}, pass_units=#{passUnits}, pass_account_id=#{passAccountId}, settlement_note=#{note}, settlement_confirmed_by=#{operatorId}, settlement_confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt}, current_settlement_id=#{settlementId}, updated_by=#{operatorId}, updated_at=#{confirmedAt}, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status='unpaid' AND settlement_status='pending'
